title: Domoticz Device Event Sensor Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=domoticz:event sensor_value=*
| stats sum(sensor_value) as total_value, avg(sensor_value) as avg_value by device_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks device values by total and average sensor value across Domoticz device event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `sensor_value` values for each Domoticz device event event and review total and average sensor value by device.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total sensor value.
grandmaExplanation: It fairly which device shows the biggest sensor value numbers in your Domoticz device event data.
